card.name: Insulin and vaccine label wording
card.fires_on: Linking words and pieces of names just before a named insulin or vaccine term, such as 'like', 'such as', 'similar to' or 'to' before insulin lispro. Also fires on the hyphen or digits inside HUMALOG U-100 and COVID-19.

modes.label: Linking word before an example
modes.description: Words like 'like', 'such as' or 'similar to' that introduce side effects or a related substance in vaccine text.
modes.example: You can lessen your risk of side effects<< like>> fainting by sitting down for 1

modes.label: Inside insulin product names
modes.description: The hyphen, digits or 'insulin' inside names like HUMALOG U-100 or insulin aspart.
modes.example: Do NOT expose HUMALOG U<<->>100 in the pump reservoir to

modes.label: Word before insulin lispro
modes.description: 'to' or 'insulin' in hypersensitivity wording about insulin lispro.
modes.example: HUMALOG is contraindicated in patients who have had hypersensitivity reactions to<< insulin>> lispro or any of the excipients

card.writes: No clear output effect beyond weak, mixed word-start hints.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words and name parts in insulin and vaccine label text.
